scientific_integrity: An exact all-positive-rate mathematical argument using explicitly calculated matrix entries, a negative discriminant, Bernstein positivity, and a unique positive-root test; finite verification is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Closed directed three-cycle and fixed classical explicit third-order end-step only; stagewise positivity, other networks and floating-point behavior unproved; no independent mathematical audit.
title: A sharp positivity frontier for third-order Runge–Kutta on heterogeneous directed triangles
